turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How are you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'm doing OK. Thank you. How are you?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I'm well thanks. What brings you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So, usually we go to my favorite pizza spot for lunch and these last couple of days I've noticed I just can't taste it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, when you say the past couple of days, do you mean two days, three days, four days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say the last two days, yeah, just yesterday and today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so loss of taste, so you can't taste anything or you can only taste some things or you're just not getting the full depth of your taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I really noticed it with the pizza, but with like other things too, it's just a yeah, really plain, it doesn't  really have any flavor with the food that I'm eating.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so it kind of tastes like cardboard.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, kind of, and I think, like, I mean part of that is that I maybe not smelling it as well either.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK. Umm, did you have any trauma to the area like the mouth area or the nose area in the past couple of days or days leading up to that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no, not at all, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and do you have a fever at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, I don't think so no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you have a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've had a cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, a similar timeline?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that's when the cough started, maybe three or four days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And is it a dry cough or a wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's a dry cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so no sputum, no blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No sputum and and no blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you feel wheezy at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No wheeziness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, maybe after coughing, I've had a hard time catching my breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, sure, yeah. And how about any fatigue? Do you feel like you're more tired than usual?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, these past few days I have definitely. I felt more tired, I've been sleeping a lot more throughout the day and just I don't know, kind of lazy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, and I know you mentioned you're having a hard time tasting. How about your appetite though? Do you feel like you've lost appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think appetite's been OK. I've been hungry.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK umm, how about muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no, just tired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, do you have a feeling like your heart's racing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any changes in your bowel movements?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, yeah, well, I had diarrhea this morning actually.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so some diarrhea this morning.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: None before that though. It was just the one or kind of two times, but it hasn't happened since then.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, no constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No blood in your stool?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I know I didn't see anything red.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about your stool seeming like it's very dark? Almost to the point where it looks black?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh no, it it wasn't dark like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good, any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any issues swallowing food?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no issues swallowing food. My throat has felt a bit itchy. I mean I've been coughing alot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Does it feel sore as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not really or just kind of yeah, kind of scratchy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had a runny nose or a blocked nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK, any rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no. I haven't noticed any rashes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are things normal with your urine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah they are.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about dizziness or fainting spells?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, a little bit dizzy I when I got out of bed this morning, but we sat back down for a couple of minutes. I felt better.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good good. Do you think that this morning you were dizzy because you were dehydrated? Or is this like a normal thing for you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I mean, I guess I could have been dehydrated. I didn't even think of that, but I mean, since the food didn't taste so great, I don't know. I probably didn't eat as much yesterday or the last couple of days. Maybe I haven't eaten as much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, Yep. OK, do you feel weak?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't know, maybe. Maybe a little weak, but umm, just way more tired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any confusion or memory loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no, I have been able to do some of my school work.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good. And you mentioned no rashes, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No rash.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any weight loss over the past couple of months?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: : Nothing like that. No weight change, it's been the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about umm night sweats or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I felt a bit, umm, hot but not sweaty, just hot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so kind of like you have a fever?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I guess so, maybe.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure any muscle aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no muscle aches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been around anyone who's been sick recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah there is this guy in my class who was sick in class last week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What kind of symptoms did he have?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, he had a cough and fever. Yeah, I think he had a cough and a fever and somebody said that. Maybe a sore throat or something like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so yeah, some symptoms overlap with yours I guess. Have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh no, I've been at home. We just started back at going in person to school again.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, that's good. And are you otherwise healthy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I haven't been diagnosed with any medical conditions in the past.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh good, OK. And do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Possibly cats but we don't have any pets at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good have you been around cats recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and then any hospitalizations or surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did have my appendix taken out like 4 four years ago. Yeah, at the beginning of high school, but that was the only surgeryand everything went well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you up to date with all your immunizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I am, yeah. I have my immunization card here actually.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good. Any family history of lung conditions or heart conditions that you know of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I know my grandfather had lung cancer, but he smoked his whole life also. Also diabetes but don't know if he had any heart problems though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I'm sorry I forgot to ask you, are you on any medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, I'm not.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. Oh, but I guess I use a vape every once in a while..

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: With like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it's like those flavored ones.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh OK, yeah. How often do you use that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's like a few times a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is there any tobacco in there or nicotine?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think there might be, but umm, I don't know. I usually just buy the flavored ones.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well, you should probably look into if it has tobacco or nicotine, because neither of those are good for your health. And so we can, you know, have a discussion later on trying to cut down or quitting completely if you are open to that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I'll just continue on asking you some other questions. Do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Umm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And who do you live with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live with my mom, my step dad, and then my younger sister.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you guys live in a house?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: We live in a townhouse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, in the city you said?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, I live close. I go to high school not too far from here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh, that's nice. And any concerns with the living arrangements in terms of you know, like it being an old building, old carpets, mold, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I live in a nice place. It's usually like really clean.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, good, umm alright, so those are all the questions I had for you. Did you have any questions or any concerns that you wanted to bring up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I guess the only thing that I was concerned about was possibly having COVID.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, you know, that's probably top on my list of things to investigate you for, so I would say COVID or other viral illnesses that could be going around this time of year. That would have less of a similar presentation, and so we will do a COVID swab for you. And in the meantime, if you could isolate for 14 days, regardless of whether the swab comes back positive or negative, and that would be great. If the swab comes back positive, we will notify public health and they'll try to trace where you could have caught this from and if it turns out it's not a viral illness, we will try to work you up for any bacterial infections which can be treated with antibiotics. So that's where we will start, does that sound good?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that makes sense.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK great, well have a great day.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, thank you.
